$comment: Schema property paths we have deliberately decided NOT to track. Consulted ONLY by the nightly schema-coverage check (scripts/schema_coverage.py) to suppress issues for properties GitHub's ruleset schema has that our templates intentionally omit. This does NOT affect the per-PR diff — that check tracks exactly what the templates define. Paths use dotted form: top-level ruleset props as their name; rule variants as 'rules.<type>'; rule params as 'rules.<type>.parameters.<param>'.
